Enumerate the targetable prior slots

Source: R/priors.R
get_prior.Rd

The set_prior() counterpart of brms's get_prior(): one row per slot a prior can target, with the class/coef/dpar/group values to pass to set_prior(). The default in every slot is flat (this is maximum likelihood until priors are set; the formula route of frmtmb.sample::frm_sample() has its own brms defaults, which prior_summary() reports). Classes "sd" and "cor" are targeted by group and nlpar; class "theta" rows name the raw internal covariance parameters (escape hatch, including correlations one at a time).

Usage

get_prior(formula, data = NULL, family = NULL, data2 = list())

Arguments

formula

A bf() formula (with family), a plain formula, or an already fitted frmtmb_fit.

data

A data frame of model data (ignored when formula is a fit).

family

Family, when formula does not carry one.

data2

Structural objects, as in frm() (ignored when formula is a fit, which carries its own).

Value

A data frame with columns prior, class, coef, group, dpar, nlpar, resp, lb, ub.

Details

A nonlinear parameter's coefficients are listed under class "b" with its name in the nlpar column, the intercept among them, which is how brms lists them and what set_prior() addresses (see its Nonlinear parameters section).

Examples

dd <- data.frame(y = rnorm(60), x = rnorm(60),
                 g = factor(rep(1:6, 10)))
get_prior(bf(y ~ x + (1 | g)) + gaussian(), data = dd)
#>                     prior     class    coef group  dpar nlpar resp lb ub
#> 1 student_t(3, -0.1, 2.5) Intercept                                NA NA
#> 2                  (flat)         b                                NA NA
#> 3                  (flat)         b       x                        NA NA
#> 4    student_t(3, 0, 2.5) Intercept               sigma            NA NA
#> 5    student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                NA NA
#> 6    student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd             g                  NA NA
#> 7                  (flat)     theta                                NA NA
#> 8                  (flat)     theta theta_1                        NA NA
